input.brief: E-Prescription by Odyssey: Philippine doctors issue Rx prescriptions as secure links; patients pay by GCash/Maya QR to unlock; SaaS plans for doctors and clinics

direction.name: One motif
direction.idea: Take one shape from the subject and let it run the whole system. A drilling tool's octagonal cross-section becomes the buttons, the image masks and the loader. A two-account money app becomes two circles that recur as icon, inline dot and section colour. A café's striped awning becomes every band on the page. Look at the product, the logo, the object or the word in the headline and find the simplest geometry in it (a circle, an arc, a chamfer, a stripe, a notch, a ring). Then use only that shape, at three or four very different scales, everywhere a designer would normally reach for a generic rounded rectangle.
direction.composition: Hero: the motif appears once at enormous scale as a flat filled shape, cropped by the viewport (a circle 120vh across entering from the right, a chamfered block filling the lower half), with a short headline at 6–8vw and one supporting sentence set on the remaining ground, left-aligned on a shared margin. Through the page the motif returns as: the mask for every photograph (via `clip-path` or `border-radius` made from the same geometry), the shape of the primary button, the bullet beside list items at text size, and one full-width band that separates the two halves of the page. Sections use simple two-column or single-column layouts so the shape is the only thing with character.
direction.typography: A clean geometric or grotesk face that echoes the shape (round bowls for circles, squared terminals for chamfers). Medium weight; headings 6–8vw in the hero and 3–4vw after.
direction.colour: The motif carries the accent colour at large scale, flat. Everything else is ground and ink. A second motif colour is allowed only if the subject has a real pair (two accounts, two modes).
direction.imagery: Photographs appear inside the motif's shape. If there is product interface to show, it sits on a flat colour stage shaped by the motif. Draw the shape with CSS or a simple inline SVG path; do not draw illustrations.
direction.richness: One shape at many sizes. The giant cropped shape gives the hero mass and colour without a single image.
direction.pitfalls: One motif means one. A circle here, a hexagon there and a blob behind is the generated look this replaces. The motif must come from the subject and you must be able to say from where in one clause.

hero.name: Fragment on a shaped stage
hero.blueprint: A neutral ground. The headline occupies the upper-left third: two lines at clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px), medium weight, flush left on columns 1–6 at a 40px margin, starting 150px down. One supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, follows, then the single action as a small rectangular button. The rest of the screen belongs to one flat stage in a saturated colour: it spans columns 5–12, begins 42% down, and bleeds off the right and bottom edges. Its top-left corner is cut with the product's own shape using `clip-path` (a notch, a chamfer or a tab two columns wide), the only decoration on the page. On the stage, 56px in from its left and top edges, sits the main fragment of the interface at true size with labels at 13–15px, built in HTML and working: one panel or control about 620px wide, cropped by the bottom edge, never a whole window and never inside a browser or laptop frame. Mark its root with data-ui. Navigation is a plain row at 28px from the top: wordmark left and four text links right at 15px. Nothing overlaps the headline.
hero.mobile: The headline sits under the wordmark at 10vw on two lines, followed by the sentence at 16px and the button. The stage comes next at full width, bleeding off both sides and the bottom, its corner cut kept at 72px wide. The fragment sits 16px inside it at true size; if it is wider than the screen the right edge crops it rather than scaling it down.
hero.headline: A plain statement of what the product does in three to six words, two lines of up to about 16 characters each at 5.2vw.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: One card, four fields
sections.blueprint: Four flat colour fields stand side by side across the full viewport, each 25vw wide and 84svh tall, butted together with no gaps; neighbours differ clearly in lightness. The same card from the product (a ticket, an order, a request) appears once in each field at the same height, 38% down, centred, 260px wide at true size, each copy marked data-ui. It is further along every time: bare as it arrives, then with an owner and a due date, then with its checklist half ticked, then closed with its final figure. Along the bottom of each field, 28px in, one clause at clamp(22px, 2vw, 32px) on two lines begins with its order word: 'First it lands here.' 'Then someone takes it.' The heading, two to four words at the same size in the heaviest weight, sits top-left in the first field only. On hover a field's card rises 6px over 150ms.
sections.mobile: The fields stack, each full width and 64svh tall, colours meeting edge to edge. In each: the clause at 24px top-left with 20px margins, then the card at true size, left-aligned, 32px below. The heading sits in the first field above its clause, at 24px in the heaviest weight.

sections.name: Object on a disc
sections.blueprint: One section about a viewport tall on a plain ground. A flat filled disc 64vh across, in one palette colour, sits with its centre at 58% of the width; swap the disc for the subject's own shape if it has one. A cut-out object photograph stands in front of it, centred on it, about 78% of the disc's height and breaking the disc's outline at the top. Bottom-left, starting on the margin and ending level with the disc's lower edge: a vertical list of four to six item names at clamp(28px, 2.9vw, 44px), leading 1.15. The selected name is in full ink and the rest at 25%; choosing a name swaps the object (300ms crossfade) and the disc's colour. The heading, two to four words at the same size as the names but in the soft ink, is the first line of that list. One fact about the selected item sits at the disc's right edge at 17px.
sections.mobile: The disc comes first, 86vw across and centred, with the object in front. The names follow as a single sideways-scrolling line at 26px with 24px gaps, the selected one in full ink. The fact sits under the names at 16px.

sections.name: Shape-marked small points
sections.blueprint: For the many minor points that do not deserve a row each. Columns 1–5: one photograph inside a single large shape taken from the subject's own geometry (a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), made with clip-path or border-radius, about 78svh tall and pushed 12% past the section's left edge so the viewport crops it. Columns 7–12: the heading, two to four words at 40–48px, then 56px lower a grid of eight to twelve points in three columns with 40px column gaps and 44px row gaps, no cells and no fills. Each point is a title at 17px medium preceded by the same shape drawn at cap height (0.7em, flat fill, inline SVG or a styled span), then two lines at 15px in the soft ink. The small shapes take a different palette colour per column, which is the only colour on the right side.
sections.mobile: The shaped photograph comes first, 82vw wide, cropped by the left edge and no taller than 60svh. The heading follows at 30px. Points become one column with 28px between them; the small shape hangs in the margin to the left of each title, so titles and text share one edge.

sections.name: Two plans, two fields
sections.blueprint: Two plans stand side by side as two full-height colour fields that meet at a hard vertical edge with no gap: the left field spans columns 1–5, the right 6–12, both 90svh tall and bleeding to the viewport edges. Each field has its own flat colour and its assigned text colour. Inside each, on a shared grid: the plan name at about 5vw top-left with 40px padding; one sentence at 20px beneath it, no wider than 26ch, saying who the plan is for; then, anchored to the bottom-left, the price at about 10vw with the period at 18px beside it; and a rectangular button anchored bottom-right on the price's baseline. What is included is written as a short paragraph, not a tick list. The unequal widths say which plan matters more without any badge. No heading spans the two fields.
sections.mobile: The fields stack, each 70svh tall, the more important plan first. Name at 12vw top-left, sentence beneath, price at 24vw at the bottom-left, and the button full width along the bottom edge inside 20px padding. The hard colour edge between the two is kept.

sections.name: Accordion of filled tiles
sections.blueprint: A two-part row. Columns 1–4 hold the heading, two to four words at about 4vw, `position: sticky; top: 96px` so it stays while the list scrolls past. Columns 5–12 hold the accordion: each question is a filled tile one step from the page ground, with 8px between tiles, no border and the page's one radius (or its motif's corner). A closed tile is 72px tall with the question at 20px medium on the left, 24px padding, and on the right a plus sign drawn from two 3px bars 16px long. The open tile switches to the accent colour with its assigned ink, the plus becomes a minus by rotating one bar, and the answer appears at 17px, no wider than 52ch. Build each tile as `<details>` with a shared `name` so one opens at a time. Six to nine tiles.
sections.mobile: The heading sits above at 9vw, not sticky. Tiles run full width with 6px gaps, questions at 18px wrapping to two lines, closed height at least 64px. The open tile keeps the accent colour, and answers are set at 16px with 20px padding.

sections.name: The object returns
sections.blueprint: The thing shown in the hero comes back once, from another angle, to close the page. On one flat field 90svh tall, the object's photograph occupies columns 1–8, scaled to about 130% of that area and anchored so the section's bottom and left edges crop it (`overflow: hidden` on the section; on light fields `mix-blend-mode: multiply` removes a white studio background). The text sits small in columns 10–12, vertically centred: a closing line of three to five words at 32–40px, one sentence at 17px, the price or key fact on its own line at 22px, and one rectangular button. Nothing overlaps the object's focal area. Where the page's subject is a shape rather than a photograph, the page's motif takes the object's place at the same scale as a flat filled shape. The closing line is the only heading.
sections.mobile: The text block comes first: closing line at 28px, sentence, fact, full-width button. The object follows at 130% of the screen width, shifted so the right and bottom edges crop it, filling about 55svh on the same flat field.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: Midnight
references.idea: The headline's circles are literally pictured: one blurred dark ring, sliced into horizontal bands, becomes the hero, the demo panel, the session cards and the footer.
references.hero: No navigation at all. A canvas fills the full width and the top 90% of the viewport: a huge out-of-focus dark navy ring on drifting taupe, sage and terracotta, cut into horizontal bands about 78px tall that are slightly offset like blinds. On the vertical centre line, starting 58px from the left, sit a small rounded-square line icon and a one-line headline at 48px in cream. On the same baseline, starting 59% across, a two-line 17px statement whose first sentence is white and bold while the rest drops to half opacity. The cream page background shows as a 90px strip at the bottom. No button.
references.type: Public Sans only, weight 500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 48px, mid-page statement about 38px on five centred lines, body 13–17px. Signature device: within one paragraph the first sentence is full strength and the remainder faded, replacing the usual heading-plus-subhead pair.
references.colour: #f4efe6 #07172a #867768 #687674 #a8735c #faf7f1 — Warm cream pages against midnight navy; the gradient mixes muted taupe, sage and terracotta around the dark ring. A peach-cream fills the small pill button. No bright accent anywhere.
references.imagery: An animated blurred ring gradient with band displacement and fine grain, used full-bleed in hero and footer, inset with 8px corners as the demo panel, and miniaturised onto three portrait session cards. No photos or UI screenshots.
references.layout: 30px side margins. Sections alternate between full-bleed gradient and cream type-only screens. Section headers split into left title and right small paragraph. Text blocks are short and often occupy one half of the width, leaving the other empty (the FAQ sits entirely in the right half).

sections.description: A full cream viewport with one centred paragraph of five lines at roughly 38px, about 820px wide. Only the opening sentence is dark; the remaining words are pale and darken progressively with scroll. Later, three small portrait cards, each about 115×180px with a mini gradient, a date at the top and a two-line label bottom-left, fan across the right side of the text, overlapping it with a soft shadow.

Header row: a two-line title at 34px on the left, a three-line 12px grey paragraph in the last fifth on the right. Below, a gradient panel spans the full content width, about 650px tall with 8px corners, holding a centred question at 34px in cream, a one-line caption, and an email capsule with an inline peach button; a small play capsule sits centred near its bottom edge.

A left-aligned two-line lead uses the dark-then-faded sentence device. Under it a two-by-two arrangement with no cards or borders, columns starting at 0 and 50%: each item is a 24px pale rounded-square icon, a quoted question as a 13px semibold title, then three or four lines of grey 12px text about 300px wide. A waitlist capsule floats fixed at bottom centre.

FAQ rows with hairlines and chevrons occupy only the right half of the screen above. The footer is the gradient again, full-bleed and about 190px tall: a two-line cream statement at left, an email capsule with inline button at right on the same line, and a row of tiny grey legal links along the bottom.

steal: Slice a soft blurred gradient into horizontal bands with small offsets so a familiar glow becomes a recognisable, ownable texture.
Replace heading-plus-subhead with one paragraph whose first sentence is full contrast and the rest half opacity.
Remove the nav from the hero entirely and put headline left and supporting line right on one shared baseline at mid-height.

references.name: SSTR - Friction Reduction
references.idea: Drilling hardware treated like precision consumer tech: a chamfered octagon taken from the tool's cross-section drives the buttons, icons and loader.
references.hero: The captured first viewport is the preloader: a 2 by 2 grid with hairline dividers, top-left quadrant solid orange with the slash-prefixed name at 5.6vw in black bold grotesk; top-right dark with a plus-sign dot grid and an orange square beside a percentage; bottom quadrants hold wireframe octagon stacks under small labels. The real hero is a full-bleed grey 3D render of a steel downhole tool rising from bottom centre. A two-line uppercase headline at about 3.5vw in light grotesk sits left-anchored at mid-height, with a short paragraph and an orange chamfered-corner button below. A slim bar holds logo left, five small caps links, globe and contact right.
references.type: ABC Monument Grotesk: bold for the loader mark, but headlines are regular or light uppercase with tight tracking at roughly 36 to 50px over 14px body. Uppercase labels at 10 to 11px carry a square orange bullet. Statistic numerals jump to about 6.7vw in a thin weight.
references.colour: #18191b #eff0f1 #ff5a2a #2f3032 #c3c4c8 — Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate; one safety orange marks buttons, bullets, the loader block and the highlighted chart series. Renders are desaturated steel so orange never competes.
references.imagery: Desaturated 3D renders of drilling tools, full-bleed in the hero and as a long drill string bending along a well path; thin wireframe octagon line drawings as service icons; a chart drawn in dots.
references.layout: Content sits inside vertical hairline rails about 35px in from each edge, with sections subdivided into two or three bordered cells. Dark and light sections alternate. Text blocks are left-aligned and narrow; a pinned well-path sequence breaks the grid with a full-bleed scene.

sections.description: Light grey section inside vertical hairline rails. An uppercase two-line heading at about 2.4vw sits top-left with an orange chamfered button under it. Below, three equal columns divided by hairlines, each about 230px tall: a wireframe line drawing of stacked octagons in the upper half, then an uppercase title at 13px and three lines of small grey body. No fills, no icon circles, no shadows.

Graphite section split into two bordered cells. Left cell, vertically centred: a tiny bracketed before-and-after range in caps, a statistic at about 6.7vw in thin grotesk, a one-word label and an orange chamfered button. Right cell: a line chart drawn entirely in dots, white for the baseline and orange for the improved run, with faint axis labels and a two-item legend using short colour bars.

Pinned full-viewport dark scene. A 3D drill string enters at top-left, runs down, bends through ninety degrees and continues along the bottom to the right edge, with bright tool segments spaced along it. A text block right of centre holds a small orange-bulleted label, a four-line uppercase statement at about 2vw and two lines of body. Bottom edge: a back-to-start link left, a chevron scroll cue centre, a skip link right.

steal: Derive one shape from the product (here a chamfered octagon) and reuse it for button corners, icons and loader graphics.
Draw charts with dots rather than lines and reserve the accent colour for the one data series you want read.
Turn the preloader into a branded four-cell grid that previews the site's colour blocks and wireframe icons.
references.media: A full-bleed 13s monochrome loop of a drilling tool descending over grey sand covers the whole fold with the text straight on it at the left, oversized for parallax. Below: a full-bleed WebGL chapter with the caption right of centre and a depth gauge at the edge, line-drawn icons in three equal cells, dot-plot charts beside big figures zigzagging per row, a 4:1 product strip under a giant product-code heading, and 3:2 case photographs in a right-hand column; 33 images and 3 videos, 0px radius.
references.motion: On desktop the video plays from 400ms while every text line shows as a solid orange bar the size of the line, like redaction, and the type replaces the bars by 1.2s. Under Lenis the hero video parallaxes at scrub 2, heads rise as masked lines over 0.6-0.82s expo.out at a 0.04-0.06 stagger, chart dots switch on one by one (1004 rects at 0.15s), stats roll digit columns, the WebGL chapter is step-locked with skip controls, and buttons fill with a clip-path sweep over 0.375s; there are 10 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: Odyssée
references.idea: A medical-aesthetics clinic presented like a skincare editorial: soft-lit close-ups of skin and slow muted loops carry the page, a thin navy serif voice argues for method over myth, and the page ends on a rolling pearl engraved with the wordmark, one polished object that stands for the result.
references.hero: A full-bleed muted video portrait (a woman resting her chin on her hands in pale grey-blue studio light) fills the screen, followed at once by a second full-bleed close-up of lips and jaw. No headline: a single 42px strip crosses the exact vertical middle in white, the serif wordmark at x=20, an 18px serif tagline about medical aesthetics at column 3 (x≈255), and four tiny tracked caps links on the right ending in the booking link, which all but vanishes against the pale picture. The strip holds while both pictures pass under it, then becomes a sticky 42px header. The entrance is a flat warm grey veil carrying only the wordmark and tagline, lifting over about 2.5s.
references.type: Two families. psTimes, a condensed Times-style serif at weight 350, for statements at 48px (3.3vw) and 32px and for titles and the tagline at 18px, sentence case, leading about 1.0-1.05, every statement with a first-line indent of one column. Basel Grotesk at 430 for 14px body and 12px lightly tracked uppercase labels and links; the house version sets those in sentence case at 16px. Fixed px sizes per breakpoint, no clamp().
references.colour: #fffcf8 #1e305e #ffffff #28292a — A warm cream ground behind nearly everything, one deep navy for 88% of the text, the progress rule and a duotone on secondary pictures, white only over photographs. A single small red dot on a live clock is the only accent; the photographs supply skin tones, pale grey-blue studio grounds and a champagne pearl.
references.imagery: Soft, even studio light on pale grey-blue backgrounds, natural skin with no retouching gloss, tight crops (lips, eye, nostril, knees) and one face turned 90 degrees for tension; slow, nearly still muted loops of skin, serum drops and bubbles used as living photographs; a navy duotone on two link cards. Square corners and cover crops everywhere.
references.layout: 20px outer margins on a 12-column grid (columns about 117px). Text has two anchors: column 3 (x≈255) for statements, body and labels, and the exact centre line for right-half paragraphs and cards. Media is always full-bleed, an exact half (720/720) or flush tiles with no gutter. Cream gaps of 232-552px separate sections, roughly one idea per screen; the closing contacts huddle in the left half.

sections.description: A 48px light serif statement on three lines from column 3 to the right margin with a one-column first-line indent, a small 108x161 double-portrait thumbnail docked at the left margin, then 14px body in a narrow column and a booking link.

Pinned for four steps: a counter, a label and a 1400px rule whose navy fill grows a quarter per step, over four 350x263 muted 5s video tiles flush edge to edge; the active tile at full strength, the other three washed to about 10%, each with an 18px serif title beneath.

Split on the centre line: a tall 672x1233 muted skin close-up holds the right half while scrolling, a small 233x291 clip of a serum drop sits just left of centre with a short caption, and a three-word 48px serif headline arrives at x=20 at mid-height.

Contact rows, an opening-hours table where only today is in full navy, and a live local clock with a pulsing dot; then the page lifts away to reveal a fixed full-bleed 9s loop of a pearl rolling on a pale grey surface with the wordmark engraved round it.

steal: Make video behave like photographs: muted, looping, with posters, 5-29s of nearly still subjects started by script when they come into view, square corners and cover crops everywhere.

Give every serif statement a first-line indent of exactly one grid column and anchor the block at column 3 with 20px outer margins, so the indent reads as a deliberate grid step; use the exact centre line as the second anchor for half-width pictures and right-half paragraphs.

End on real local detail (an hours table that marks today, a live local clock), then reveal a fixed full-bleed brand object as the last screen. The site's tiny white caps nav over pale skin all but disappears; the house version is a plain bar with the booking action as a real button.
references.media: Video is the main medium: a 27s portrait loop and a second close-up fill the first screen, then four 5s tiles flush edge to edge, a 720/720 diptych, a tall half-width clip held while scrolling, a full-bleed band that fades up from cream, two navy duotone cards, and a fixed pearl loop revealed under the footer. Nine images and eight muted, looping videos with posters, started by script; no canvas.
references.motion: No preloader: a warm grey veil lifts off the hero video over about 2.5-3s with the type already in place. Under Lenis the features section pins for four steps, cross-fading tiles over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) as the navy rule grows, images fade over 0.5s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), underlines grow by background-size over .4s expo-out and the page lifts off a fixed bottom layer to reveal the pearl, but content is opacity-gated, so mid-scroll frames show empty cream, and there is no reduced-motion rule.
